question:
A solid sphere of radius 7{ cm} is coated with a layer of paint that increases its radius to 7.5{ cm} , find the volume of the painted layer.

(Use pi = 22/7 and round off your answer to the nearest integer)
solution:
Volume of layer = 4/3 × π × (R³ − r³)

R = 7.5 cm, r = 7 cm

Volume = 4/3 × 22/7 × (7.5³ − 7³)

Volume = 88/21 × (421.875 − 343) = 88/21 × 78.875

Volume ≈ 330.52 → 331 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 331 cm³.**
